segments: Version scope: the original notes use examples centered on NixOS 24.05, Python 3.11, Node 20, and similar versions. Historical pins are retained below for context; 24.05 should not be treated as a currently security-supported branch. When migrating, choose inputs that are still supported and assess changes to the pinned source and options.
Avoid configuration drift and ensure reproducibility:
Unable to boot because of a configuration error

Disable swap only after confirming that free memory can accommodate the swapped-out pages and that no critical workloads are running. Otherwise, you may run out of memory. This is not a general-purpose performance fix.
NixOS Chinese community
The limits of reproducibility, updates, and backups

flake.lock pins inputs; automatic updates deliberately change the inputs and system state. allowReboot = false only restricts automatic reboots, not the application of service changes. A Borg configuration also requires checking repository initialization, permissions, encryption, and recovery drills. System rollback is not a substitute for backing up /home data.
